==Description==
'''Retro Crossroads''' is a [[Maps|map]] where the path intersects itself near the middle of the map. It has been remade twice since its addition to the game. It is a retro version of [[Crossroads]], meaning its style is based around old Roblox.

==Design & Path==
'''Retro Crossroads''' is a blocky version of the [[Crossroads]] map. It is split into four distinct quadrants. First one is a black mountain with a few castle walls on it. The second quadrant contains a small flat area, then a few grey and orange cliffs with various structures. Next quadrant contains an even bigger flat area, then a few yellow and green cliffs. It does not contain anything other than a few cliffs and entrances inside the cave. The last quadrant is entirely flat. It contains a tall structure and a trampoline. All quadrants are surrounded by a yellow wall.

The path starts at a green spawn point and ends at a red spawn point. the path is mostly straight, mainly taking turns in the flat quadrant. The path intersects in the middle of the map.

==Rewards==
The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}}, {{Gem|Gems}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts are multiplicative with other modifiers present on this map.

Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal.

{{Rewards|Easy|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide}}

==Strategy==
*Since the path crosses twice in the middle of the map, it is suggested to place ground towers near it.
**Melee towers and towers with short range, like the [[Shotgunner]] or [[Warden]] excel at this spot
**Towers that deals damage overtime such as the [[Pyromancer]] can be placed here as well, enabling them to deal the damage twice.
***Additionally, the [[Pyromancer]] can utilize its pierce to hit more enemies.
*The path where the enemies spawn is long and narrow, making it a great spot for [[Archer]]s and [[Shotgunner]]s as they are able to hit more enemies with their piercing. 
*This map has a lot of cliff spots, making cliff towers very useful here.
**Do note that some cliff spots may be far away from the path. You can use [[DJ Booth]] to increase the range of your towers.
*Since the map goes around a loop, the [[Ace Pilot]] is able to cover most of the path when placed inside the loop.
